<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex023042026-11-0403-16-03" status="unreviewed">
            <milestone unit="section" n="Post-colophon Verses (71a6-71a9)"/>
        <lg> <l><rs type="deity">rgyal ba sras bcas</rs> <expan>thams cad</expan> kyi || </l>
         <l>bsgrod pa 1 pa'i lam chen 'di || </l>
         <l>gzhu [=gzhi?] lam 'bras bu gsum du bzhed || </l>
         <l>'bras bu shes rab pha rol phyin || </l>
         <l>gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so || </l></lg>
         
         <lg>
         <l>de la de bzhin gshegs pa zhes || </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3771">phyogs kyi glang po</rs>s gsungs pa yin || </l>
         <l>lam ni dri ma Na [=med] pa'i yid || </l>
         <l>chos can chos nyid dbyed ba med || </l>
         <l>gsal la mi rtog gnyis su med || </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">rgyal sras rnams</rs> kyi laM mchog yin ; </l>
         <l><lb edRef="inst:4643" n="71a7"/> gzhung ni <rs type="work">rgyas 'bring rnam 3</rs> ste || </l>
         <l>sde tshan dgu ru <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">jo bo</rs> bzhed || </l>
         <l>de dag <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">dgongs 'grel mngon rtogs rgyan</rs> || </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ref="db:3747">rje brtsun byams pa</rs>s mdzad pa la || </l>
         <l>de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng ge bzang po</rs> yis || </l>
         <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711">rnam par 'grel</rs> du mdzad pa 'di || </l>
         <l>1 nas 2 su brgyud pa'i || </l>
         <l>gdaMs pa mnga' ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3745">a ti sha</rs>'i || </l>
         <l>sras chen <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4235">khu</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3788">rngog</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3727">'brom</rs> gsum ste || </l>
         <l>dam pa bzhi'i slob ma ni || </l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="">dge bshes nam mkha' bla ma</rs> yin || </l>
         </lg>
         
         <lg>
         <l>de la <lb edRef="inst:4643" n="71a8"/> <rs type="person" ana="">pra dz+nya ke ru</rs> yis || </l>
         <l>gzhung dang gdams par bcas pa gsan || </l>
         <l>de la <rs type="person" ana="">chos kyi blo gros</rs> kyis || </l>
         <l>mnyes par byas nas <expan>nyams su</expan> blangs ||  </l></lg>
         
         <lg><l>de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3919">zhang 'bal tshad ma ba</rs>s || </l>
         <l>gsan nas nges shes shin ltu skyes || </l>
         <l>dad par gyur nas ma bslad par || </l>
         <l>gdams pa'i bzhed lugs yi ger bris || </l></lg>
         
         <lg><l>bsre ru phangs pas ma bslad zhes || </l>
         <l>phyi ma rnams la'ang de skad du || </l>
         <l>yang yang <lb edRef="inst:4643" n="71a9"/> gsung zhes slob dpon gsung || </l>
         <l>de skad thos nas bris pa lags || </l></lg>
     × dge'o || ×  man+galaM || × b+ha ban+du || × || × || × || × || × ||</seg></TEI>
